study: Wunderle et al., Frontiers in Aging Neuroscience (2024), German motor function study
design: 444 healthy adults aged 21–88, non-left-handed by Edinburgh laterality criterion. Both sexes and all ages combined. Each hand value is the mean of three alternating measurements on a rubber-ball vigorimeter in kPa. The paper defined the ratio as the person's nondominant divided by dominant reading.
interpretation: This is the distribution of ratios across individuals, not a correlation or the ratio of marginal means. The ratio is dimensionless. A pressure measurement and a dynamometer force in kg can have different relative error. Dominant/nondominant labels can differ from right/left and this study pooled strata. No subgroup correlations, target joint rates or kg-scale calibration are supplied.
